deliverable: Standalone private full-script selfie review video
timing_authority: The verified full R4 Original C WAV, not the native generated soundtracks
steps: Select silent source boundaries after words 68 and 124 on the 24 fps frame grid, moving only within the actual quiet interval
Produce three generation reference WAVs from contiguous source samples; no speech retiming
Generate each exact passage with the same identity, room, clothing and camera reference, using its current audio timing
Trim native pictures to the exact first and second audio section frame counts and sufficient real ending coverage for section three
Join native video only with two sentence-pause cuts and one CRF17 H264 intermediate encode
Run one global Sync v3 restoration against the unchanged full R4 WAV
Measure output-minus-source audio offset and drift across the whole result; verify full final word and remaining picture coverage
Losslessly remux the result to video-first H264/AAC faststart delivery and use the previously successful phone host
minimum_total_picture_frames: ceil((full_voice_duration_seconds + 1) * 24), subject to actual generated end coverage
continuity_review: Inspect both sides of each join and representative frames of all three segments before and after global Sync. Global Sync does not repair pose or lighting discontinuities.
integrity_review: Preserve original source PCM; never concatenate independently AAC-encoded voice segments into the final soundtrack. Do not infer exact lip sync or natural performance from transcript and waveform checks alone.
runtime_note: Read-only inspection found no currently installed/running Resolve application at the former path or standard application locations. Existing Higgsfield media-processing and phone-packaging route is used for this standalone format experiment; no Resolve conform, canonical episode integration or release is claimed.
permissions_basis: Current owner instruction to use this exact script in the ongoing funded own-avatar video workflow; existing outputs and unrelated repository work preserved
